name: Ballymote
text: Ballymote is a town in the county of Sligo in the west of Ireland. Its name means townland of the mount. An old Irish manuscript, the Book of Ballymote, was put together at this place. That book is a storehouse of medieval Irish learning and stories.

attributes.attribute: gave its name to the Book of Ballymote
